existing_roles.description:
Responsibilities:

MaxLinear is seeking an accomplished Senior Director to lead the Company’s worldwide Quality organization and drive a culture of continuous improvement. In this role, you will focus on the following:

  

* Global Quality Leadership and Strategy
  + Establish and execute the company’s global quality strategy, ensuring the highest levels of product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle from design and development through wafer fabrication, assembly, test, and customer delivery
  + Align quality strategy to business objectives, product roadmaps, and customer expectations
  + Lead and improve the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with industry standards and customer requirements
  + Establish quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to drive measurable improvements
  + Partner throughout the organization to integrate quality into all business processes
* Supplier and Manufacturing Quality
  + Provide strategic quality leadership across the global semiconductor manufacturing supply chain, including wafer foundries, bumping, assembly, packaging, test, and substrate suppliers
  + Establish and maintain robust supplier quality management processes, including qualification, audits, performance monitoring, and corrective action programs
  + Drive supplier quality improvements through structured root cause analysis, process controls, and continuous improvement initiatives, improving quality, manufacturing consistency, and supply-chain resilience
  + Establish supplier scorecards and metrics covering defect rates, yield, process stability, responsiveness, and corrective action effectiveness
  + Lead supplier quality escalations involving manufacturing excursions, yield deterioration, reliability concerns, and customer-impacting quality issues
  + Drive supplier process change management and ensure appropriate qualification and requalification prior to production implementation
* Product Quality and Reliability
  + Establish quality and reliability requirements throughout the semiconductor product lifecycle, from new product introduction (NPI) to high-volume manufacturing, and work with internal teams to ensure product quality and reliability requirements are incorporated into product development
  + Oversee product qualification and reliability programs, including HTOL, temperature cycling, HAST/uHAST, ESD, latch-up, and other applicable qualification testing
  + Drive effective failure analysis, root cause identification, corrective actions, and preventive actions (CAPA)
  + Enhance processes for monitoring product quality, manufacturing yields, defect trends, and field performance
  + Lead cross-functional investigations into product failures, parametric shifts, reliability excursions, and customer returns
  + Ensure robust product change control, qualification, and release processes
* Customer Quality and Satisfaction
  + Serve as the senior quality interface for strategic customers, particularly during major quality escalations and critical customer engagements
  + Establish a customer quality management process to improve satisfaction and strengthen relationships
  + Lead timely and effective resolution of customer quality issues, including containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness
  + Oversee customer quality reporting, failure analysis, 8D reports, and corrective action commitments.
  + Partner with Sales, BUs, and Engineering to address customer concerns and protect customer relationships and business continuity
  + Establish processes to monitor customer quality performance, field returns, and customer satisfaction metrics
* Quality Systems, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
  + Maintain and continuously improve quality systems in accordance with applicable standards, including ISO 9001 and IATF 16949
  + Ensure compliance with automotive quality requirements, customer-specific quality standards, and relevant semiconductor industry requirements
  + Drive implementation of advanced quality methodologies, including: Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Design and Process Qualification, 8D Problem Solving, Six Sigma and Lean methodologies, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Reliability and Failure Analysis
  + Lead internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of findings
  + Leverage data analytics and automation to improve quality monitoring, identify emerging trends, and enable predictive quality management
* Organizational Leadership and Development
  + Build, develop, and lead a high-performing global Quality organization
  + Establish clear organizational responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability across the team
  + Develop the team’s technical and leadership capabilities through mentoring, training, and succession planning
  + Drive a culture where quality is viewed as a shared organizational responsibility rather than solely a Quality department function

Qualifications:

* Strategic leadership experience combining strong technical expertise in semiconductor quality and reliability with excellent supplier management, customer engagement, organizational leadership, and problem-solving capabilities
* Extensive experience managing quality across a complex global ecosystem of foundries, outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partners, substrate suppliers, and other critical manufacturing partners
* Extensive experience in a fabless semiconductor business model, managing quality across outsourced manufacturing partners
* Experience working with leading wafer foundries, assembly and test subcontractors, and semiconductor supply-chain partners
* Track record of leading complex supplier quality and customer quality escalations
* Experience managing global teams and working with suppliers and customers in Asia, Europe, and North America
* Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, including wafer fabrication, wafer probing, bumping, assembly, packaging, and final test
* Deep knowledge of semiconductor reliability qualification, failure mechanisms, and failure analysis
* Strong understanding of quality systems, supplier qualification, process controls, and product change management
* Experience with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AEC-Q100, JEDEC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements
* Expertise in structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, FMEA, SPC, CAPA, and Six Sigma
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience using quality data to drive systemic improvements
* Experience with high-volume semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging technologies is highly desirable
* BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 15 years of experience, or MS + 13 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 10 years of experience

Compensation and Benefits:

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $187,000 to $251,000 Annually

**Position Overview**

Onboard Systems Hoist & Winch, located in Anaheim, CA is one of the world’s leading providers of Search & Rescue (SAR) and Human External Cargo (HEC) advanced mission equipment for civil, commercial, and military helicopters.

The Director of Quality is a key leadership position reporting directly to the General Manager (GM), responsible for establishing and executing the company's overall quality strategy. This role provides strategic direction and oversight of the Quality function, ensuring the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), compliance with AS9100 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, and continuous improvement across all business operations. As the designated FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, the Director has authority over all Part 145 repair-station operations, ensures personnel follow applicable FAA regulations, and serves as the primary contact with the FAA. The Director also partners with executive and operational leadership to drive quality performance, manage organizational risk, and foster a company-wide culture of quality and accountability.

**Location:** Anaheim, CA (on-site)

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday

**Pay:** $180,000 - $225,000, plus bonus eligibility

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Quality Management System Leadership**

* Establish quality strategy, policies, and measurable objectives aligned with the company's business goals.
* Own and administer the company-wide Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100 (which incorporates ISO 9001) and applicable customer and regulatory requirements, including FAA and, where applicable, EASA requirements.
* Oversee the FAA Part 145 repair-station quality control system, including the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, Operations Specifications, and documented inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Ensure the QMS is effective, scalable, consistently deployed across the business, and aligned with the company's growth and product roadmap
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives to optimize quality processes, procedures, documentation, and controls.
* Manage document control and maintain accurate, controlled quality procedures, process documentation, and compliance records.

**2. Compliance & Customer Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for external audits, including AS9100 certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory assessments.
* Prepare the organization for audits and lead audit responses, corrective actions, and follow-up activities to verify effective closure.
* Build and maintain credibility and trust with executive stakeholders, aerospace OEM customers, auditors, regulatory officials, and relevant industry partners.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable standards, customer requirements, and contractual quality clauses.
* Oversee incoming, in-process, and final manufacturing inspections, including first article inspection (FAI) activities to AS9102 when required by contract or approved procedures, while maintaining distinct FAA Part 145 maintenance-inspection and return-to-service controls.

**3. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure timely containment and investigation of quality issues using methods such as A3, 8D, and 5 Whys, with documented root cause and corrective action (RCCA).
* Support Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams with timely quality guidance and issue resolution.
* Establish quality KPIs and targets, monitor trends, and report performance and improvement plans to the GM and leadership team.
* Use data-driven insights to improve customer satisfaction, compliance, and product consistency; reduce defects and cost of poor quality (COPQ); and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate product safety, airworthiness, quality, and compliance risks; escalate significant issues to leadership and track mitigation actions to closure.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for nonconforming product and airworthiness concerns; prevent unauthorized product release and ensure release decisions remain with appropriately authorized personnel.
* Lead internal audits and management reviews to ensure ongoing system effectiveness.
* Provide technical leadership and ensure team competency in precision metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Lead a risk-based supplier quality program covering supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and supplier corrective-action follow-up.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration and Team Leadership**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Program teams to embed quality into design, production, and supplier processes.
* Support new product introduction (NPI) with quality planning, risk assessments, and validation activities.
* Lead and develop the Quality team through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the organization through training, mentorship, and leadership by example.

**Who You Are**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of aerospace quality experience, including senior leadership responsibilities and significant responsibility for AS9100-based quality systems.
* Deep working knowledge of aerospace quality principles and requirements.
* Experience working with major aerospace OEMs and their quality expectations.
* Demonstrated experience leading internal, customer, and third-party certification or regulatory audits.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, discipline, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and communicate effectively with customers, auditors, and executive leadership.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a small, high-impact Quality team.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Working knowledge of 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, including the distinction between production airworthiness approvals and maintenance return to service, and applicable FAA Form 8130-3 issuance and signatory-authorization requirements.
* Experience with FAA-certificated Part 145 repair-station requirements, including regulatory interface and oversight of inspection and return-to-service controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of metallurgy and material certification review.
* AS9100 lead auditor training or equivalent demonstrated experience leading aerospace QMS audits.
* Background supporting NPI, supplier quality, and manufacturing quality operations.
* An advanced degree in a related discipline.
* ASQ or other relevant quality certifications, such as CQE or CQA.

**What’s In It for You**

* Benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.

We recognize employee contributions toward growing the business through our Growth Participation Unit (GPU) program. GPUs are tied directly to company growth and reward all eligible employees with cash when the business grows over time.

existing_roles.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director of Quality and Risk Management is responsible for providing strategic leadership, oversight, and direction for both the Quality Management and Risk Management programs within the organization. This role develops, implements, and monitors a hospital-wide, data-driven quality improvement program designed to enhance patient outcomes, reduce medical errors, and minimize risks to patients, staff, visitors, and property. The Director ensures compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., The Joint Commission (TJC), Title 22, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and other applicable standards) and fosters a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety throughout the organization.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Quality Management & Performance Improvement***

* Develop and Implement Quality Programs:

* Design, implement, and monitor a comprehensive, hospital-wide quality management and performance improvement program.
* Direct the collection, measurement, and analysis of quality data to identify trends and drive process improvements.
* Education and Training:

* Provide in-service education and training to clinical and administrative staff on quality improvement methodologies, regulatory standards, and data management.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and resource on quality improvement initiatives and continuous quality improvement (CQI) processes.
* Compliance and Reporting:

* Monitor compliance with TJC, Title 22, CMS, and other regulatory standards.
* Oversee the accuracy and timeliness of quality data submissions and reports for internal and external stakeholders.

***Risk Management***

* Manage Risk Programs:

* Oversee the organization’s Risk Management Program by developing and implementing strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks to patients, staff, visitors, and property.
* Coordinate the investigation and reporting of incidents, patient/visitor complaints, and potential liability events.
* Incident and Claims Management:

* Maintain and oversee the hospital-wide occurrence reporting system.
* Direct the investigation and documentation of incidents and claims, ensuring that trends are identified and appropriate corrective actions are taken.
* Serve as the primary liaison with internal departments, legal counsel, and external agencies regarding risk management issues and claim defense.
* Evidence Preservation and Litigation Support:

* Safeguard materials obtained during root cause analyses and ensure proper documentation and preservation of evidence.
* Negotiate settlements for minor claims within administrative authority and coordinate litigation support activities when necessary.

***Leadership & Strategic Integration***

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

* Work closely with senior leadership, clinical staff, and departmental managers to integrate quality and risk management initiatives across the organization.
* Chair or participate in committees (e.g., Patient Safety/Risk Committee) to promote a unified approach to quality and risk management.
* Staff Development:

* Mentor and coach quality and risk management staff to foster professional growth and enhance departmental performance.
* Lead the development of rapid-cycle improvement teams and task forces to address quality and risk-related issues.
* Continuous Improvement:

* Actively participate in continuous quality improvement (CQI) initiatives and contribute to the overall strategic direction of the organization
* Support human resources and performance improvement efforts through active participation in team conferences, staff meetings, and orientation programs.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* General:
* The role primarily involves office work with extended periods of sitting, as well as occasional standing and walking.
* Manual Tasks:

* Frequent use of hands for typing, data entry, and document handling.
* Occasional lifting of light items up to 10–25 pounds may be required.
* Vision:
* No special vision requirements beyond standard capabilities.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* The position is based in a typical office/hospital environment with standard ambient noise levels.
* Occasional exposure to areas with moderate activity levels.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to permit qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or a healthcare-related field is required.
* Master’s Degree is preferred.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of five (5) years of quality and/or risk management experience in an acute care hospital setting is required.
* At least two (2) years of supervisory or administrative management experience is preferred.
* Experience in risk investigation, claims management, and regulatory compliance is highly desirable.

**Licenses/Certificates:**

* Certified Professional Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) is required or must be obtained within one year of hire.
* Other risk management or quality certifications are a plus.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Demonstrated leadership and management skills with the ability to motivate teams, delegate responsibilities, and drive organizational change.
* In-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements including TJC, Title 22, CMS, and applicable local and federal regulations.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in data collection, performance measurement, statistical analysis, and quality management information systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and familiarity with healthcare information systems and databases.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to negotiate and resolve complex issues.

existing_roles.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Marvell's Connectivity firmware organization delivers firmware for our connectivity and optics product lines. This role owns the full Architecture & Quality function for that portfolio. Architecture and quality operate as one integrated group, a shared resource to every firmware team and not a gate in front of them.  
  
You will set the technical architecture direction for the portfolio and hold the quality bar across it, treating the two as a single end-to-end responsibility. Architecture shapes what can be verified, and quality is how we prove it, from requirements through release and into the field. You will be accountable for how architecture decisions are made, how firmware is verified and released, and how well the firmware, hardware and systems teams work together. You will lead a global team of senior technical leaders and are expected to build depth in a function that is currently concentrated in a few people.

**What You Can Expect**

This is one function, not two. Architecture decisions set what can be tested, and quality findings feed straight back into architecture. You will own the full lifecycle from requirements and design through verification, release and field support.

**Architecture that is built to be verified**

* Product and systems architecture across the Connectivity firmware portfolio: reference architectures, standards, design reviews and technical decision records, each with testability and observability designed in.
* Product hardware interlink: the architectural contract between hardware and firmware, covering requirements, interface definition, bring-up readiness and silicon-to-firmware feedback loops, with validation criteria agreed up front.
* CMIS and optics architecture: firmware architecture for CMIS-based modules and optics products, including spec compliance, feature roadmap and interoperability, tied directly to conformance and interop test plans.
* Architecture governance that scales: lightweight review processes, clear ownership and reusable components, so teams move faster instead of waiting on reviews.

**Quality as an end-to-end discipline**

* Quality strategy that starts at requirements and architecture review, not at test execution: shift-left practices, requirements quality and design-for-test standards owned jointly with the architects.
* Software Quality Assurance (SQA) strategy and execution: test strategy, automation, regression coverage, release qualification and defect trends.
* Release readiness and quality gates for all firmware releases, with clear exit criteria and a straight, data-backed go/no-go recommendation.
* Quality metrics and reporting to Engineering leadership, Product Management and customer-facing teams.

**Closing the loop**

* Customer-escape and defect analysis that traces root causes back to architecture, interfaces and process, and turns the learning into updated patterns, standards and test coverage.
* A single set of metrics and quality signals shared across architecture, interlink, optics and SQA, so design risk and test findings are managed in one view.

**Organization**

* Lead and develop a global organization (30+).
* Grow and retain senior technical talent, and manage the pipeline, hiring, succession and career paths for architects and quality engineers.
* Build a collaborative partnership with Firmware, Hardware, Systems, Product and Program Management, and with the Optics and telemetry teams.
* Own the function's budget, headcount plan, requisitions and tooling or lab investments.

**Your Team**

You will lead a small team of senior leaders and architects who together cover the function end to end, with architecture and quality responsibilities intentionally overlapping:

* Software quality assurance and release qualification.
* Hardware and firmware interlink.
* Optics and module architecture.
* Product and systems architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set a multi-year architecture and quality roadmap aligned with product and customer priorities, and drive it across engineering teams that do not report to you.
* Make and communicate hard trade-offs between schedule, scope and quality, and own the release recommendation.
* Raise the architecture bar: consistent patterns, reuse across product lines, and early detection of design risk before it becomes schedule risk.
* Shift quality left: embed test, automation and requirements quality earlier in the lifecycle, and invest in CI/CD, simulation, emulation and lab infrastructure.
* Represent Architecture & Quality in executive reviews and in technical engagements with key customers and standards bodies.
* Keep the function independent and credible: escalate quality risks directly and transparently, including when the news is unwelcome.
* Build the next layer of leadership so the function does not depend on any one person, and set clear delegation across the architecture and SQA leads.
* Manage a distributed team across time zones with clear rituals, ownership and handoffs.

**What We're Looking For**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
* 15+ years in embedded firmware or systems software for semiconductor, networking or optical products, including 8+ years leading managers or senior technical leaders.
* Track record owning both architecture and quality outcomes for shipping firmware products at scale.
* Deep working knowledge of firmware architecture for connectivity or optics products, with direct experience in HW/FW co-design and silicon bring-up.
* Hands-on experience with test strategy and automation, release qualification and quality metrics for complex, customer-deployed products.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple sites and cultures, including offshore QA/SQA organizations.
* Proven executive communication: able to present risk, trade-offs and recommendations to VP-level and customer audiences.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with CMIS and optical module firmware (for example 400G/800G and coherent or pluggable optics), and related industry standards and interoperability programs.
* Familiarity with Ethernet PHY, retimer, DSP or SerDes firmware, and with security features such as MACsec.
* Experience with secure firmware update, recovery and lifecycle practices.
* Background building or transforming an SQA organization, including automation and CI/CD maturity.
* Experience in a matrixed, platform-style organization where architecture is a shared service.

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

218,850 - 327,800, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

**Scope:**

existing_roles.title: Director, PXT - Amazon Leo Production Operations
existing_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has committed more than $10 billion to Amazon Leo, a low Earth orbit satellite network designed to bring fast, affordable broadband to customers around the world. Production Operations is where that ambition becomes physical. Every Leo satellite weighs more than 1,000 pounds, contains roughly 4 million individual components, and is designed and built in-house on a 172,000 square foot custom production line in Kirkland, Washington, capable of producing up to five satellite a day. The team completed its 1,000th satellite in September 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-builds-satellites), making Leo one of the largest and most advanced satellite production operations in the world.  
From the factory, satellites move to a 100,000 square foot payload processing facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida that can support three launch campaigns at once, and to launch operations in French Guiana. With more than 80 launches secured across four launch providers, Leo plans to double its launch rate to more than 20 missions in its second year. The organization spans eight sites today across multiple states and ground stations across multiple countries, with more investments coming through in the times ahead.  
This role builds on Amazon's deep operations heritage and takes it to newer heights. You will partner with an organization that brings together aerospace, RF, supply chain and manufacturing experts, recruited from the leading space and defense companies, alongside a skilled hourly production and launch workforce building and launching satellite in clean rooms, across shifts, and on mission-critical launch campaigns. Few people leaders anywhere get to shape all of this at once: precision satellite manufacturing across multiple satellite generations, export-controlled and government production, and Amazon Leo's first employing entity outside the US.  
The people decisions made in the next 18 months will shape this organization for the next decade. As the senior PXT leader for Production Operations, you will make them alongside the VP of Production Operations and the multiple Directors who lead satellite manufacturing, launch operations, supply chain, quality, ground gateways, global trade and compliance, enterprise technology, and Manufacturing Systems Engineering and New Product Introduction. You won't be inheriting a playbook. You'll be writing it.  
What makes this role unique  

* Two talent markets, one interwoven strategy. Build differentiated people programs for a highly technical corporate workforce competing in one of the most constrained talent markets in the world, and for a large, fast growing hourly manufacturing and launch workforce, under a single coherent people strategy.
* Organization design at a defining moment. Shape org design, leadership formation, and succession as the organization scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production in parallel, with a leadership team forming as it grows.
* People infrastructure Amazon has never built. Create job families, compensation, and career frameworks for roles Amazon has never hired before, people processes for export-controlled and cleared work, and Amazon Leo's first non-US employing entity at a launch site.
* Proactive employee and labor relations. Set a direct-engagement and labor relations strategy for an hourly workforce, across factories and launch sites in multiple states and countries.

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as strategic people partner to the VP of Production Operations and Director-level function leaders, advising on organizational design, talent architecture, site strategy, and workforce planning across corporate technical and hourly populations.
* Shape the multi-year organization design for Production Operations as it scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production, including new leadership roles and structures.
* Lead talent strategy for specialized technical roles (aerospace manufacturing, RF and telecommunications engineering, satellite quality, supply chain and trade compliance, AI and automation), competing against established aerospace and defense employers.
* Build scalable HR infrastructure for a 24/7 manufacturing and launch operation, including new-to-Amazon approaches to timekeeping, attendance, performance management, and shift support.
* Lead people strategy for Launch Operations, including sustainable staffing models for launch campaigns, rotational teams, off-shift coverage, and recurring travel.
* Set a proactive labor and employee relations strategy in partnership with Global Employee Relations and Labor Relations, coaching senior operations leaders on direct employee engagement at every site.
* Define people requirements for export-controlled and government manufacturing, including security clearances, cleared hiring pipelines, and compliant people processes, with Legal and Security.
* Stand up Amazon Leo's first non-US employee population at an international launch site, including employment contracts, compensation and benefits, payroll, and statutory compliance.
* Drive leadership development, calibration, promotion readiness, and succession planning across a rapidly expanding senior leadership bench.
* Build and lead a team of HR Business Partners, operating through a deep matrix across HR Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Talent Management, Employee Relations, PXT Technology, and international partners.

  
Click the link to see how Amazon’s growing constellation of custom-built satellites will work together to bring internet connectivity anywhere on the planet: https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-satellite-internet-works

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of progressive human resources experience
* 10+ years of experience as an HR business partner supporting senior executives
* 7+ years of experience leading HR strategy for large-scale manufacturing, production, or operations organizations with hourly or shift-based workforces
* 5+ years of experience leading HR strategy for organizations operating across multiple countries and legal entities
* Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources or MBA
* Experience with employee and labor relations in union represented or union-exposed environments
* Experience designing organizational structures, compensation frameworks, and job architecture for large, fast-growing organizations
* Experience leading people strategy in aerospace, defense, satellite, telecommunications, or advanced manufacturing
* Experience supporting highly technical engineering populations alongside hourly production workforces
* Experience supporting launch, flight, field, or campaign-based operations with rotational or travel-intensive staffing
* Experience designing people processes for export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) or government cleared work environments
* Experience standing up new sites, greenfield operations, or new country employing entities
* Track record of building senior leadership teams and coaching executives through rapid organizational change
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and to build mechanisms that scale beyond any single leader

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

Welcome to CTI Foods, where quality, service, and people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a leading food manufacturing company, dedicated to providing our customers with the best possible products and our employees with a rewarding career.

At CTI, we passionately believe that people are our #1 ingredient. We provide a positive and supportive work environment, opportunities for growth and advancement, and a competitive compensation package. We value our employees' contributions and strive to create a culture of respect, teamwork, and excellence.

Whether you're interested in a career in production, quality control, or management, we have a variety of opportunities available. We believe that our success is a result of our focus on quality, service, and people, and we look forward to continuing to serve our customers and employees with excellence.

If you're looking for a rewarding career in the food manufacturing industry, look no further than CTI Foods! Join our team and become a part of a company that values quality, service, and people.

Job Overview:

To lead and direct production and maintenance functions for the respective location, while supporting and adhering to the efforts of safety, food safety, supply chain, human resources, and commercialization, in order to meet location’s business objectives as established by the Senior Leadership Team.

Responsibilities:

* Direct daily operations while maintaining compliance to quality and regulatory standards.
* Execute all plans and initiatives as directed by safety, supply chain, food safety, HR and other cross functional areas.
* Achieve all location KPIs.
* Achieve budget for all operating costs including manufacturing, maintenance, and labor.
* Champion and model the CTI culture and the necessary mindsets to (3Fs) to deliver optimal results.
* Actively participate and engage with other plant leaders for best practice sharing and replication for areas such as network optimization and asset efficiency.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts around plant performance, people and processes to execute on current goals and to prepare for future growth.
* Lead team by effectively utilizing CTI’s Operating Principles.
* Attract, hire and lead the supervisory teams throughout the location, ensuring that all team members are knowledgeable with operating processes and procedures.
* Ability to develop the maintenance department into a pro-active / asset life management model.
* Identify, study and determine the processing equipment that best meets production needs from a product quality and productivity standpoint.
* Play a key role on major CAPEX project budgeting and large project management to ensure timely completion and on budget.
* Define and model the overall facility capacity to have an overall understanding of bottlenecks and limitations.
* Knowledge of USDA-FSIS regulations and ability to work with USDA inspectors on an ongoing basis to ensure compliance to all USDA regulations and HACCP and SQF requirements.
* Knowledge of other regulatory requirements, including OSHA and EPA/DNR. OSHA experience covering worker safety in a protein processing environment as well as ammonia-based refrigeration. EPA/DNR as it pertains to plant discharges either by air or water.
* Maintains continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and continuing needs.
* Any other duties as assigned.

  
Qualifications:

What we need from you:

* Minimum of 10 years of operations management experience, food manufacturing preferred.  
  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Food Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* Ability to apply understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram form.
* Track record of strong performance as a senior operations manager with demonstrated operations and management talent and a desire to participate in a team environment.
* Demonstrated experience in organizational and process improvement, ideally with using Lean, Kaizen, and Six Sigma concepts.
* Long term and short-term planning skills.
* Budget development and presentation skills.
* Ability to effectively analyze and evaluate new equipment and new processes and assign a value for reduced labor, yield improvement, or quality improvement.

* Must be able to adapt to and become an advocate of the company mission and vision statements.
* Team member who will quickly earn and maintain the personal and professional respect of people inside and outside the Company.
* Articulate and effective communicator with the ability to influence others through the employment of sound judgment.
* Maintains professional demeanor, high standards of integrity, honesty, loyalty, and ethical values.

What you'll receive from us:

* Unlimited PTO\*
* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Company Paid Life Insurance
* Telehealth Services
* 401K Matching
* FSA & HSA available
* EAP and wellbeing support
* Tuition reimbursement program available

* *The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range of candidates hired. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. Most candidates will start in the bottom half of the range. Unlimited PTO requests are subject to approval and is subject to the current business needs of CTI Foods.*

existing_roles.description:
LISI AEROSPACE is ranked 60th in the global aerospace value chain and specializes in the design and manufacture of high-tech metal components to enhance aircraft safety and performance. Active since 1950 in the fastener market (no. 3 worldwide), LISI AEROSPACE has been a recognized player in metal components for aircraft engines and airframes since 2011. With its dedication to industrial excellence, LISI AEROSPACE aims to become a leader in costs, quality, deadlines and workplace safety. This mindset is represented at every level of our company and by all of our team members. At LISI AEROSPACE, we focus above all on advancement and flexibility. Every employee is empowered and has the latitude they need to carry out their assignments and develop their skills. We provide this mobility and training through our Corporate University, the LISI Knowledge Institute (LKI). As a result, our company is growing fast and always welcoming new talents.
  
  
**COMPENSATION:** $160,000.00 - $200,000.00 annually
  
  
**SCHEDULE:** 4/9 + 4
  
  
SUMMARY
  
The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for production, delivery and quality of highly engineered aerospace fasteners, utilizing machining, forging, thermal treatment and coating operations. In addition to these responsibilities, the Director of Manufacturing will also be responsible for safety, environmental results, efficiencies and effectiveness of the assigned production unit and/or groups. The individual will act as a senior management representative in the assigned production units and ensure that company policies and guidelines are accurately interpreted and implemented. Develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes and methods in accordance with product specifications and quality standards. Minimize process variation and maximize efficiency of both existing and new product manufacturing process.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodation for disabilities may be made for one or more of the following:
  
  

* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for profit and loss results as established for the assigned production units by the organization’s budget or forecast process.
* Responsible for achieving and sustaining agreed health and safety goals while using effective management techniques to communicate goals, corrective action and create an environment of best-in-class safety practices.
* Responsible for the manufacturing and planning of best-in-class products in the assigned factory, utilizing world class techniques, clear achievable goals that align with the corporate business strategy.
* Ensure customer service levels are met and that delivery/quality Key Production Indicators (KPI) are tracked and communicated.
* Responsible for staff development, assessments, and ensuring new team members selected to join the organization have the training and development necessary to integrate them into our continuous improvement culture.
* Establishes goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPI) to assigned production units to be flowed down from P&L, HSE, Customer Service Performance, and Quality goals that are communicated and tracked on a regular basis to ensure production group activity aligns with production unit goals.
* Works with inter-departmental or cross functional staff to resolve issues with machinery, product quality, product development, Health, Safety, and Environmental, and continuous improvement.
* Develops, implements, and tracks clear action plans to improve agreed upon deficiencies with the use of problem-solving techniques, such as 8D corrective actions, statistics, capability studies (SPC), Total Preventative Maintenance (TPM).
* Plans and develops capital equipment forecasts using input from others, in order to achieve safety improvements, increased productivity, and optimizes our core skills.
* Manages professional and non-professional staff to achieve their goals through goal setting, performance appraisals, counseling, and team building.
* Must be able to prioritize and manage resources to achieve projects results even when time and/or resources are constrained.
* Ensure quality management system is adhered to and improved as a part of our continuous improvement effort.
* Organize and maintain high standards of performance, quality and customer service within all departments.
* Responsible for implementing company policies and guidelines as prescribed by management
* Supports, leads, and adheres to all business accreditations, such as AS9100, ISO14001, and others as acquired or required.
* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for and ensuring that all employees attend all training provided and for adhering to all HSE procedures, policies, and plans, conforming to reporting requirements, and safe operating procedures at all times.
* Responsible for ensuring employees in assigned area are aware of their requirement to bring any known or suspected nonconformance for all company procedures or legal requirements to management’s attention immediately.

Ways of Working, Experience, and Behaviors
  
  
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
  
  

* Analytical – Ability to analyze and understand complex information, product specification, and critical technical information. Able to resolve complex problems to resolution. Able to scrutinize information providing direction and guidance on risks, strategy, planning, and actions
* Technical Skills – Technical knowledge including but not limited, to specification interpretation, product application, product quality, quality systems, International Standards, safety and environmental management, customer relationship management, project management, Lean concepts, Six-Sigma, and people development and leadership.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens intently to others and seeks clarification; Provides clear and pleasant responses to inquiries regardless of the situation; Presents complex concepts in a simple manner to achieve understanding at all levels of the organization. Demonstrates group presentation skills working in a global environment; actively participates in meetings providing clear information.
* Written Communication – Writes documents clearly and accurately. Transfers production data into meaningful written documents that can be understood by all levels of the organization. Writes comprehensive well-developed policies and work instructions. Writes clear actions and audit reports.
* Teamwork - As management Team Member must lead by example, adhere and apply all company and legal regulations. Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Places success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed; Follows the company guiding principles and values; Recognizes accomplishments of team members.
* Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns actions and department activities and action plans to mission, vision and strategic goals.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities of self and others; Uses time efficiently; Plans for resources in a creative way only adding cost as absolutely necessary; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

Supervisory Responsibilities
  
  
Directly and/or indirectly supervises Supervisors/Managers, and other team members assigned to the production units and production groups; Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the assigned production units. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the HSE responsibility, organization's policies and applicable laws; Responsibilities include but are not limited to interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  
  
Education and/or Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree (Engineering background preferred) from a four-year college or university. Master’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience in the Aerospace Industry or Manufacturing environment preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years related experience required or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Customer interface/interaction experience related to understanding of customer specifications, quality and satisfaction required.

Language Skills
  
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Must be able to write accurate reports, business correspondence, technical manuals, policies, and procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
  
  
Mathematical Skills
  
Ability to work with highly complex mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
  
  
Reasoning Ability
  
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract concrete variables.
  
  
Computer Skills
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have advanced knowledge of Computer software programs for word processing, spreadsheets, presentation such as but not limited to Microsoft Word; Microsoft Excel; Microsoft Access, Project Plan or corrective Action system.
  
  
Certificates, licenses, registrations
  
  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT, HEALTH AND ,SAFETY
  
  
Physical Demands
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time, and to speak or listen. The employee is frequently required to sit and requires eye-hand coordination, repetitive hand movement and manual dexterity use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand for extended periods of time and walk. The employee must occasionally bend, reach to shoulder level and lift, carrying, pushing and/or pulling up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus. Hearing level within normal/average range.
  
  
Work Environment

Description:

**Who we are and what we value:**

Feed Energy works at the intersection of feed, fuel, and agriculture, building a nearly four-decade legacy of stewardship across the industries we serve. We support how America nourishes its people and powers its economy. Our team is made up of growth-minded individuals dedicated to transforming global practices in feeding and fueling. We create circular economies through sustainable, low-carbon products and processes. Join us if you are looking for a dynamic environment where you can help shape a more sustainable future.

**We help feed the world by providing safe, energy-based nutrition solutions.**

Creativity • Stewardship • Impact • Integrity • Healthy Relationships

**What we are looking for:**The Head of Plant Operations is a highly visible, hands-on leader responsible for operational performance across all Feed Energy manufacturing facilities. This role leads Plant Managers and the Senior Operations Support Manager, establishes consistent operating standards, and ensures the plants function as one integrated operating system.The Head of Plant Operations owns the execution of safety, quality, production, cost, reliability, and continuous improvement priorities across all locations. A key focus of the position is developing plant leadership capability, reinforcing accountability, and building the operating discipline required to deliver consistent results. This position reports to the Chief Operations Officer and requires up to 60% travel.

**What you will do:**

* Lead day-to-day operational execution across Feed Energy’s four manufacturing locations.
* Own plant performance targets, including throughput, yield, uptime, labor efficiency, cost per unit, and total operating cost.
* Establish consistent daily, weekly, and monthly operating routines, KPI reporting, and escalation processes.
* Maintain a visible presence on plant floors by observing work, coaching leaders, supporting problem-solving, and building relationships with frontline employees.
* Manage Plant Managers and the Senior Operations Support Manager, setting clear expectations and reinforcing accountability for results.
* Develop Plant Managers, supervisors, and frontline leaders through coaching, feedback, and hands-on leadership support.
* Manage plant operating expenses, including labor, maintenance, utilities, consumables, and outside services, within the approved operational budget.
* Partner with Finance on expense forecasting, variance management, and operating cost inputs for capital planning.
* Lead the daily execution of safety and environmental programs in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.
* Uphold product quality standards and partner with Quality to reduce defects, product holds, and customer quality concerns.
* Build and enforce consistent operating standards and standard operating procedures across all locations.
* Eliminate unnecessary differences in processes, practices, and performance between plants.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and structured problem-solving as part of daily operations.
* Coordinate operational priorities across Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and Culture and Talent.
* Model servant leadership and build a culture of safety, ownership, accountability, development, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate Feed Energy company values in all everyday work interactions.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**What you will need:**

* At least 10 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations.
* Proven experience directly leading multi-site operations, including three or more facilities.
* Demonstrated success building and implementing operating systems across multiple locations.
* Experience managing operating expenses and delivering cost performance within budget.
* Strong experience coaching and developing Plant Managers, operations leaders, supervisors, and frontline teams.
* A servant leadership mindset with the ability to establish clear expectations and accountability.
* Willingness to spend substantial time in manufacturing facilities and personally engage in operational problem-solving.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to partner effectively across operational, technical, financial, and people-focused functions.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Advanced degree in Engineering.
* Experience in feed, food, chemical, lipid, or other process-manufacturing environments.
* Previous experience as a Plant Manager.
* Experience scaling operations during organizational growth or technology transitions.
* Experience using ERP and MRP systems, such as SAP or Oracle

**What we provide, because we care!**

In addition to a competitive annual salary, this position will be eligible for an annual performance-based bonus. We offer a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and wellness reimbursement, a generous 401(k) match of up to 6%, paid time off and holidays, and continuing education support.  
**Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa support. The company will not sponsor employment visas at this time.**

existing_roles.title: Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems
existing_roles.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk-takers, the trailblazers, the game-changers. We're not perfect, and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. But our drive is unrivaled, just like our athletes. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A day in the life:**
----------------------

As the Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems, you will own the design, implementation, and optimization of Monster's end-to-end supply chain planning landscape within the SAP ecosystem. Your primary focus is SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) covering demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, order based planning and the roadmap of S/4HANA.

You will also guide the connected Manufacturing and Quality solutions, including SAP PP, PP/DS, production execution, and SAP QM, so that planning decisions flow cleanly into the plant floor and quality processes. You will set global processes, solution architecture, and governance; lead a team of SAP IT professionals; and partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality leaders to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**The impact you'll make:**
---------------------------

***Supply Chain Planning (primary focus)***

* Own the global SAP planning solution, with SAP IBP and SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS) as the core platforms, and define the target architecture and roadmap, including to S/4HANA.
* Lead solution design and configuration decisions across demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, and response/deployment planning.
* Lead planning projects from inception to completion, including implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and migrations, delivered on time, in scope, and on budget.
* Establish planning master data standards, parameter governance, and integration between IBP/APO, S/4HANA, and connected systems (e.g., RTI, CPI).
* Serve as the point of contact on emerging trends in supply chain planning and evaluate solutions that improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and inventory performance.

***Manufacturing & Quality (supporting scope)***

* Oversee SAP production execution solutions so that plans translate into executable production schedules across plants and co-manufacturers.
* Guide SAP QM processes, including inspection planning, batch management, quality notifications, and release, in partnership with Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Ensure end-to-end integration across Planning, Manufacturing, and Quality so the business runs on one consistent process.

***Leadership & strategy***

* Analyze business requirements, prioritize based on cost/benefit, and present a clear implementation roadmap to IT and business leadership.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of SAP specialists and manage system integrator and partner relationships.
* Partner closely with end-to-end solution verticals to understand requirements, manage business risk, and deliver quality outcomes on budget and timeline.
* Engage operations leaders to identify problems suited to AI, automation, and advanced analytics, in line with the Digital Transformation (DT) roadmap and vision.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of SAP supply chain experience working on the IT side, including hands-on process mapping, solution design, configuration, and customization.
* **7+ years of hands-on SAP IBP and/or SAP APO experience**, including at least one full-lifecycle implementation you led or owned. APO-to-IBP migration experience strongly preferred.
* Working experience with SAP PP, and production execution, and exposure to SAP QM. Depth here is valued but secondary to Planning.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP SCM implementations as part of an IT team.
* Proven track record making solution design and roadmap decisions and leading SAP teams and system integrators.
* Experience aligning teams to a common business process and driving application adoption.

***Preferred***

* Certifications: SAP IBP, APICS (CPIM/CSCP), SAP Manufacturing, or SAP Quality.
* Experience in consumer packaged goods, beverage, or other high-volume manufacturing environments.
* Background with automation and analytics tools and platforms (e.g., RPA, workflow automation, process mining, AI/ML forecasting).
* Technical skills: SAP IBP, SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS), S/4HANA, SAP PP, SAP QM, SAP Analytics Cloud, and Microsoft tools.

Production & Operational Management

* Lead and oversee daily production activities to ensure production schedules, operational targets, and delivery commitments are consistently met.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on identifying and eliminating technical, technological, and operational challenges across production lines.

* Translate and communicate company objectives into clear goals and expectations for the management team.

* Promote and reinforce a strong culture of food safety, product quality, and health and safety throughout the production organization.

* Solid knowledge of business and management principles, including strategic planning, budgeting, resource allocation, workforce planning, leadership, and operational coordination.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits.

About Ferrero:

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many **iconic brands** sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. **Our Application Process**
---------------------------

existing_roles.description:
Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you will do::

As the Plant Manager, you will serve as the senior leader of the operation, with full responsibility for the facility's operational performance, customer experience, employee engagement, and financial results. You will lead a truss manufacturing business serving residential, commercial, multifamily, and agricultural construction markets while driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and a culture centered on safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will:

* Assume full P&L responsibility for the business, including revenue growth, gross margin performance, operating expenses, EBITDA, and overall profitability.
* Develop and execute business plans that drive market share growth, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Lead all day-to-day operations of the truss manufacturing facility, including production, engineering/design, purchasing, scheduling, inventory, logistics, maintenance, and quality.
* Partner with sales leadership to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships, expand market opportunities, and improve competitive positioning.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics, identify trends, and implement action plans that improve profitability and business results.
* Maintain accountability for budgeting, forecasting, cost management, capital expenditures, working capital, and inventory performance.
* Lead and develop supervisors, managers, and frontline team members while creating a high-performance culture focused on accountability and results.
* Champion safety, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives across all aspects of the operation.
* Ensure production capacity, staffing, and operational resources are aligned with customer demand and growth objectives.
* Foster strong relationships with contractors, builders, developers, architects, engineers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead change management initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that enhance operational performance and long-term scalability.
